categories.forWho: Students enrolled at a school or university in Timor-Leste.

categories.name: Family residence
categories.forWho: Spouses and family of Timorese citizens or residents.

generalDocuments: Passport valid 6+ months with 2 blank pages
Criminal record check (often needs an apostille)

visas.summary: One of the hardest countries to enter. Most visits need a letter of invitation from the State Migration Service, requested by a tour agency, employer or host. Since October 2026 tourists and conference visitors can get an e-visa, but only through a sponsoring agency or organizer. Long stays are basically limited to employer, study or family sponsorship.

categories.name: Work visa (letter of invitation)
categories.forWho: People hired by a company or organization in Turkmenistan that requests the invitation for them.
categories.processing: Invitations can take up to a month. Embassy visa processing is often about 10 business days after that.

categories.name: Study or private visa
categories.forWho: Students at a Turkmen institution, or family invited by a host in Turkmenistan.

generalDocuments: Letter of invitation from the State Migration Service
Registration with the State Migration Service within 3 days (for stays over 3 working days)

officialLinks.label: Example: Embassy of Turkmenistan in the UK, visa info

visas.summary: Many nationalities can visit Tunisia visa-free for a limited stay, others need a visa from a Tunisian embassy. To live there, you usually enter on the right visa or status, then apply for a residence card (carte de séjour) through the police and Ministry of Interior.

categories.name: Residence card: employment
categories.forWho: Foreigners hired by a Tunisian employer. The work contract needs approval from the labor ministry first.
categories.processing: Often several weeks to a few months.

categories.name: Residence card: investor or business owner
categories.forWho: People setting up or running a company in Tunisia.

categories.name: Residence card: family
categories.forWho: Spouses and children of Tunisian citizens or residents.

categories.name: Residence card: student
categories.forWho: Students enrolled at a Tunisian school or university.

generalDocuments: Valid passport (check the minimum validity rule)
Criminal record check (often needs an apostille)

officialLinks.label: Ministry of Foreign Affairs (find your Tunisian embassy)
US Embassy Tunisia: services for US citizens

visas.summary: Many visitors get a visitor permit on arrival, while some nationalities must apply in advance. Long stays need a visa from Tonga's Immigration Division, often applied for through a Tongan embassy or directly in Tonga.

categories.name: Employment visa
categories.forWho: Foreigners working for a Tongan employer, plus volunteers and charity workers.
categories.processing: About one month, per the Tongan embassy. Applications without Ministry of Labour support are not considered.
documents: Support letter from the Ministry of Labour, Commerce & Industries

categories.name: Assured Income visa
categories.forWho: Retirees with a regular pension or overseas income. It allows living in Tonga but not working, studying or starting a business.
categories.processing: Varies. Check with the embassy or Immigration Division.
documents: Proof of income of at least TOP$10,000 a year

categories.name: Business visa
categories.forWho: Foreigners or foreign companies setting up or investing in a business in Tonga.
documents: Support letter from the Ministry of Labour, Commerce & Industries
Business plan and proof of investment (for longer stays)

categories.name: Residency visa
categories.forWho: People of Tongan ancestry, former Tongan citizens, and spouses of Tongans.
documents: Proof of Tongan ancestry or marriage

visas.summary: Many nationalities can visit visa-free or get an e-visa online. To stay longer than your visa allows, you apply for a residence permit through e-İkamet with the Presidency of Migration Management.

categories.name: Digital nomad visa
categories.forWho: University graduates working remotely for companies or clients outside Türkiye. You get a Digital Nomad ID from GoTürkiye, then apply for a visa and later a short-term residence permit.
categories.processing: Varies by consulate. The visa covers up to 90 days, then you apply for residence.
documents: Digital Nomad Identification Certificate from GoTürkiye
Proof of income of at least 3,000 USD per month (36,000 USD per year)
Remote work contract (not with a company in Türkiye)

categories.name: Short-term residence permit
categories.forWho: People staying for tourism, property ownership, business ties and similar reasons.
categories.processing: Apply online on e-İkamet, then attend an appointment. Decisions often take several weeks.

categories.name: Work permit
categories.forWho: People hired by a Turkish employer. The employer applies to the Ministry of Labor, and the permit also counts as residence.

categories.name: Family residence permit
categories.forWho: Spouses and children of Turkish citizens or residence permit holders.

categories.name: Student residence permit
categories.forWho: Students enrolled at a university in Türkiye.

generalDocuments: Valid passport (check the minimum validity rule)
Criminal record check (often needs an apostille)

visas.summary: Many nationalities can visit without a visa, while others apply for an eVisa. Long stays are handled by the Immigration Division of the Ministry of Homeland Security, mostly through work permits, student permits, or residence based on family ties.

categories.name: Work permit
categories.forWho: People with a job offer from an employer in Trinidad and Tobago. The employer applies online through TTBizLink.
categories.processing: Varies. Often several weeks to a few months.

categories.name: Student permit
categories.forWho: Students accepted at a school or university in Trinidad and Tobago. Applied for online.

categories.name: CARICOM Skills Certificate
categories.forWho: Nationals of participating CARICOM countries in eligible skill categories, who can live and work without a work permit.

categories.name: Residence (family)
categories.forWho: Spouses and close family of citizens or residents.

generalDocuments: Valid passport (check the minimum validity rule)
Criminal record check (often needs an apostille)

visas.summary: Many nationalities can visit visa-free or get a visitor permit on arrival, usually for about a month. Staying longer, working or studying needs an extension or permit from the Department of Immigration in Funafuti. Long-stay options are very limited and mostly tied to a job or family.

categories.name: Work permit (employment)
categories.forWho: Foreigners with a job offer from the government, an aid project or a local employer.
categories.processing: Varies. Contact the Department of Immigration in Funafuti.

categories.name: Residence: family
categories.forWho: Spouses and dependents of Tuvaluan citizens or permit holders.

visas.summary: Many nationalities can visit Taiwan visa-free for a limited stay. For long stays you usually get a resident visa from a Taiwan mission abroad (or convert in Taiwan where allowed), then apply for an Alien Resident Certificate (ARC) with the National Immigration Agency.

categories.name: Employment Gold Card
categories.forWho: Qualified professionals in fields like tech, science, business, finance, arts and education. It combines a work permit, resident visa and ARC, valid 1 to 3 years.
categories.processing: Can take over 60 business days, per the official Gold Card site.
documents: Proof of meeting a Gold Card qualification (salary, awards, experience, etc.)

categories.name: Digital nomad visitor visa
categories.forWho: Remote workers from visa-exempt countries who meet the income rules. This is a visitor visa, not residence.
categories.processing: Varies by mission. If already in Taiwan, apply at least 10 working days before your stay ends.
documents: Proof of remote work (contract or freelance contracts)
Annual salary of at least US$40,000 (age 30+) or US$20,000 (age 20 to 29) in one of the last two years, or another country's digital nomad visa
Bank balance averaging at least US$10,000 over the last 6 months

categories.name: Work permit and resident visa
categories.forWho: People hired by a Taiwanese employer, who applies for the work permit first.

categories.name: Student resident visa
categories.forWho: Students admitted to a Taiwanese university or full-time language program.

categories.name: Family reunion resident visa
categories.forWho: Spouses and children of Taiwanese citizens or ARC holders.

generalDocuments: Valid passport (check the minimum validity rule)
Criminal record check (often needs an apostille)

officialLinks.label: Bureau of Consular Affairs: digital nomad visitor visa

visas.summary: Most visitors need a visa, which many nationalities can get online through the official e-visa portal. Staying longer than 90 days needs a residence permit (Class A, B or C), applied for online with the Immigration Department. Most people also need a work permit from the Labour Commissioner.

categories.name: Residence permit Class A (investors)
categories.forWho: Shareholders and directors of registered companies investing in Tanzania, including self-employed people.
categories.processing: Once paid, you enroll fingerprints and the permit is usually issued within about a week. Review before that varies.
documents: Work permit from the Labour Commissioner

categories.name: Residence permit Class B (skilled employees)
categories.forWho: Foreigners with specialized skills hired by a specific employer in Tanzania. Usually applied for before entering.
documents: Work permit from the Labour Commissioner

categories.name: Residence permit Class C (other)
categories.forWho: Students, researchers, retirees aged 55+, volunteers, missionaries and NGO staff, among others.
categories.processing: Varies. Most applications are made before entering Tanzania.
documents: Proof of your purpose (enrollment, pension, NGO letter, etc.)

visas.summary: Ukraine is under martial law because of Russia's full-scale invasion, and most governments advise against all travel. Many nationalities can normally visit visa-free for up to 90 days in 180. Long stays need a long-term (D) visa from a Ukrainian consulate, then a temporary residence permit from the State Migration Service.

categories.name: Temporary residence: employment
categories.forWho: Foreigners with a job in Ukraine, including staff of foreign company offices and aid projects.
categories.processing: Varies. Expect delays under martial law.

categories.name: Temporary residence: family reunification
categories.forWho: Spouses and close family of Ukrainian citizens or legal residents.

categories.name: Temporary residence: study or volunteering
categories.forWho: Students at Ukrainian institutions and volunteers with registered programs or organizations.

generalDocuments: Valid passport (check the minimum validity rule)
Criminal record check (often needs an apostille)

officialLinks.label: State Migration Service: temporary residence permit

visas.summary: Most visitors need a visa, usually applied for online before travel. Long stays use an entry permit (work permit) from National Citizenship and Immigration Control (NCIC), with classes for investors, employees, volunteers and people living off foreign income.

categories.name: Entry permit Class G2 (employment)
categories.forWho: Foreigners employed in Uganda, including salaried NGO staff.

categories.name: Entry permit Classes B to F (investors and professionals)
categories.forWho: Shareholders of companies in farming, trade, manufacturing or mining, and partners in professions like law, medicine or accounting.

categories.name: Entry permit Class G1 (missionaries and volunteers)
categories.forWho: Missionaries and volunteers working with NGOs.

categories.name: Entry permit Class H (ordinary resident)
categories.forWho: People with income from outside Uganda who will not work there, such as retirees.
documents: Proof of income from outside Uganda

generalDocuments: Valid passport (check the minimum validity rule)
Criminal record check (often needs an apostille)

officialLinks.label: Uganda online visa and permit portal

visas.summary: Visitors either use ESTA under the Visa Waiver Program (eligible countries only) or apply for a visitor visa at a US embassy. Living in the US means a specific nonimmigrant visa (work, study, investor) or a green card, usually through family or an employer. Screening rules, visa bonds and restrictions for some nationalities changed often in 2025 and 2026, so check the State Department news before applying.

categories.name: Employment-based visas (H-1B, L-1, O-1 and others)
categories.forWho: People sponsored by a US employer, transferred within a company, or with extraordinary ability.
categories.processing: Varies a lot by category. The employer usually files with USCIS first, then you interview at a consulate.

categories.name: Family-based green card
categories.forWho: Spouses, children, parents and some siblings of US citizens or green card holders.
categories.processing: Months to many years, depending on the relationship and your country.
documents: Medical exam by an approved doctor

categories.name: Student visa (F-1 or M-1)
categories.forWho: Students accepted at a SEVP-certified school.
categories.processing: Varies by embassy. Book your interview early.

categories.name: Investor routes (E-2 treaty investor or EB-5)
categories.forWho: E-2 is for nationals of treaty countries investing in a US business. EB-5 is a green card for larger investments that create US jobs.
categories.processing: E-2 varies by embassy. EB-5 often takes years.

categories.name: Trump Gold Card
categories.forWho: People who make a 1 million USD gift to the US after background vetting, plus a 15,000 USD nonrefundable processing fee. It leads to an EB-1 or EB-2 green card. It is a new program, so check the official site for its current status before you plan around it.
categories.processing: Varies. The official site says some countries may wait a year or more because of visa limits.

generalDocuments: Valid passport (check the minimum validity rule)
Proof of your category (job petition, I-20, family documents)

officialLinks.label: US Department of State: US visas

visas.summary: Many nationalities can visit visa-free, usually for up to 90 days. To stay longer, you apply for legal residence (temporary or permanent) with the National Migration Directorate (DNM), often starting the process after you arrive.

categories.name: Digital nomad permit
categories.forWho: Remote workers and freelancers earning from outside Uruguay. You enter as a tourist and apply online.
categories.processing: Varies. The permit lasts 6 months and can be renewed once for another 6.
documents: Sworn statement that you can support yourself

categories.name: Permanent legal residence
categories.forWho: Foreigners who want to live in Uruguay long term and can show enough monthly income, from a job, a business, remote work or a pension.

categories.name: Permanent residence: Mercosur
categories.forWho: Citizens of Mercosur and associated countries, through a simpler process.

categories.name: Permanent residence: Uruguayan family tie
categories.forWho: Spouses, partners, parents and children of Uruguayan citizens.

generalDocuments: Criminal record check from your country (and anywhere you lived 6+ months in the last 5 years)

visas.summary: Many nationalities can visit visa-free, and dozens more can get an e-visa online. Long stays need the right visa category (work, investment, study, family), then registration and a residence permit through the internal affairs authorities.

categories.name: Work visa
categories.forWho: Foreigners hired by an Uzbek employer, based on a license from the Agency for Foreign Labor Migration.

categories.name: Investment visa (INV)
categories.forWho: Investors putting at least 8,500 times the base payment into Uzbekistan. Multiple-entry, valid up to 3 years, and family members can come too.

categories.name: Study visa (A-1)
categories.forWho: Students enrolled at an Uzbek institution.

categories.name: Family and compatriot visas (PV-1, VTD)
categories.forWho: People invited by Uzbek relatives, and people born in Uzbekistan and their families.

generalDocuments: Valid passport (check the minimum validity rule)
Criminal record check (often needs an apostille)

officialLinks.label: MFA of Uzbekistan: consular and visa info

visas.summary: Vatican City has no visa system and no border checks. You reach it through Rome, so Italian and Schengen entry rules apply. Residence is not open to the public: it is limited to people who live there because of their work for the Holy See or Vatican City State.

categories.name: Residence by office or employment
categories.forWho: Clergy, officials, Swiss Guards and some staff whose role with the Holy See or the State requires living in the Vatican.
categories.processing: Not an open application. Granted by Vatican authorities with the role.

categories.name: Living in Rome (Italian visa)
categories.forWho: Most people who work for the Vatican or study at pontifical universities live in Italy on an Italian visa and residence permit.

generalDocuments: Italian visa or Schengen visa-free entry, if required for your nationality
Letter from your Vatican office or institution (for work or study)

visas.summary: Most nationalities can visit without a visa if they show they are genuine visitors, while a short list must get a visa in advance. Residence and work permits are handled by the Office of the Prime Minister, and you can apply from abroad by mail or courier.

categories.name: Work permit
categories.forWho: People with a job offer from a local employer, or who are self-employed. Stays over 6 months also need a residence permit.
categories.processing: Residence and work permit applications average 6 to 8 weeks, per the Office of the Prime Minister.
documents: Job offer letter or proof of self-employment

categories.name: Temporary residence
categories.forWho: Anyone who wants to live in the country for an extended period.

categories.name: Permanent residence
categories.forWho: People with 7+ consecutive years of temporary residence, or holders of an Alien's Land-Holding Licence.

categories.name: CARICOM Skills Certificate
categories.forWho: Nationals of participating CARICOM countries in eligible skill categories.

generalDocuments: Valid passport (check the minimum validity rule)
Criminal record check (often needs an apostille)

officialLinks.label: Office of the Prime Minister: residence and work permit FAQ
UK government: Saint Vincent and Grenadines entry requirements

visas.summary: Venezuela's situation has been unstable, and several governments have advised against travel in recent years, so check your own government's advice first. Some nationalities can visit visa-free, others need a visa from a Venezuelan consulate. Long stays use a transeúnte (temporary) visa for a specific purpose, renewed through SAIME, the immigration authority.

categories.name: Transeúnte work visa (TR-L)
categories.forWho: Foreigners with a job in Venezuela.

categories.name: Transeúnte family visa (TR-F, TR-F-V)
categories.forWho: Spouses, children and parents of Venezuelan citizens or residents.
documents: Marriage or birth certificates (marriages abroad must be registered in Venezuela)

categories.name: Transeúnte rentier visa (TR-R)
categories.forWho: People living off a pension or other lawful passive income. SAIME lists roughly 1,200 USD per month for renewals.
documents: Proof of pension or lawful income

categories.name: Transeúnte student visa (TR-E)
categories.forWho: Students enrolled at a Venezuelan institution.

generalDocuments: Valid passport (check the minimum validity rule)
Criminal record check (often needs an apostille)

visas.summary: Some nationalities can visit visa-free for a set period, and most others can apply for an e-visa online, valid up to 90 days. Long stays usually mean a work permit or investment first, then a temporary residence card (TRC) from the Immigration Department.

categories.name: Work permit and temporary residence card
categories.forWho: Foreigners hired by a Vietnamese employer. The employer handles the work permit, then sponsors your work (LĐ) visa and TRC.
categories.processing: Often several weeks for each step.
documents: Degree and proof of work experience (often legalized)
Health check from an approved clinic

categories.name: Investor visa and temporary residence card
categories.forWho: Foreigners who invest in or own a company in Vietnam.

categories.name: Family visa
categories.forWho: Close family of Vietnamese citizens or of foreigners living and working in Vietnam.

categories.name: Student visa (DH)
categories.forWho: Students accepted at a Vietnamese school or university.

generalDocuments: Valid passport (check the minimum validity rule)
Criminal record check (often needs an apostille)

visas.summary: Many nationalities get a visitor visa on arrival, while others apply in advance. Stays over 12 months need a residence visa from the Department of Immigration and Passport Services, which offers routes for workers, investors, property holders and self-funded residents.

categories.name: Residence visa: Employee
categories.forWho: People employed by a Vanuatu-based business for at least 12 months.
documents: Work permit from the Labour Department

categories.name: Residence visa: Self-funded resident
categories.forWho: Retirees and others living on their own income.
documents: Certified monthly income of at least 250,000 Vatu

categories.name: Residence visa: Foreign investor
categories.forWho: People investing in a business in Vanuatu.

categories.name: Residence visa: Leasehold holder
categories.forWho: People holding a leasehold property in Vanuatu worth 10 million Vatu or more.
documents: Certified monthly income of at least 250,000 Vatu per person

categories.name: Residence visa: Partner or child
categories.forWho: Spouses, de facto partners and dependent children of Vanuatu citizens.

generalDocuments: Valid passport (check the minimum validity rule)
Criminal record check (often needs an apostille)

officialLinks.label: Vanuatu Department of Immigration and Passport Services

visas.summary: Most visitors get a free visitor permit on arrival for stays up to 60 days if they meet the entry conditions, like an onward ticket and enough funds. Longer stays, or travel for work or study, need an entry permit from Samoa Immigration, with temporary residence permits issued for work, business investment or study.

categories.name: Temporary residence permit: employment
categories.forWho: People with a job offer from an employer in Samoa.

categories.name: Temporary residence permit: business investment
categories.forWho: People investing in or running a business in Samoa.
documents: Approved business or foreign investment registration

categories.name: Temporary residence permit: study
categories.forWho: Students enrolled at a school or university in Samoa.

visas.summary: Kosovo is not in Schengen. Many nationalities can visit visa-free for up to 90 days in 180, and some others can enter with a valid Schengen visa or apply for a Kosovo visa. Long stays need a temporary residence permit from the Ministry of Internal Affairs.

categories.name: Temporary residence: employment
categories.forWho: Foreigners with a job contract in Kosovo, plus foreign business owners.
categories.processing: Varies. Check with the Ministry of Internal Affairs.

categories.name: Temporary residence: family reunification
categories.forWho: Spouses, partners and children of Kosovo citizens or residents.
documents: Marriage or birth certificate, or proof of 3 years living together for unmarried partners

categories.name: Temporary residence: study or research
categories.forWho: Students and researchers at licensed Kosovo institutions.
documents: Proof of enrollment or research invitation

categories.name: Residence for Albanian citizens
categories.forWho: Albanian citizens, under criteria from the Kosovo to Albania agreement.

generalDocuments: Valid passport (check the minimum validity rule)
Criminal record check (often needs an apostille)

officialLinks.label: Ministry of Internal Affairs: temporary residence permit
Ministry of Internal Affairs (services for foreigners)

visas.summary: Yemen is in an ongoing conflict and most governments, including the UK, advise against all travel. Everyone needs a visa from a Yemeni embassy, and you must register with immigration if you stay more than 14 days. Long-stay options are mostly limited to aid work, sponsored employment or family ties.

categories.name: Work or humanitarian residence
categories.forWho: Staff of aid organizations, the UN or employers able to sponsor them.

categories.name: Family residence
categories.forWho: Spouses and children of Yemeni citizens.

generalDocuments: Visa application form from a Yemeni embassy

officialLinks.label: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Yemen

visas.summary: Many nationalities can visit visa-free, others apply for a visa (an e-visa is available for some). Long stays need a temporary residence visa from the Department of Home Affairs (DHA), usually applied for from outside the country through its visa centers.

categories.name: Critical Skills work visa
categories.forWho: People whose skills are on the official Critical Skills List.
categories.processing: Often several weeks to a few months.

categories.name: General work visa
categories.forWho: People with a job offer from a South African employer.
categories.processing: Often several weeks to a few months.

categories.name: Remote work visa (visitor's visa)
categories.forWho: People employed by or earning from companies outside South Africa who meet the income threshold. You cannot take a South African job on it. It is new, so confirm with Home Affairs or your nearest South African mission that it is being issued.
categories.processing: Varies. Check DHA for current requirements.

categories.name: Retired persons' visa
categories.forWho: Retirees with a pension or enough income or assets to support themselves.
categories.processing: Often several weeks to a few months.
documents: Proof of pension or monthly income

categories.name: Relative's visa
categories.forWho: Close family of South African citizens or permanent residents.

generalDocuments: Passport valid 30+ days after your stay, with 2 blank pages
Police clearance from each country lived in for 12+ months

officialLinks.label: Department of Home Affairs: immigration services
Department of Home Affairs: types of visas

visas.summary: Many nationalities can visit visa-free, and many others can get an e-visa. Ordinary visitors staying more than 90 days need a visiting permit. To live, work, study or invest in Zambia you need an immigration permit from the Department of Immigration.

categories.name: Employment permit
categories.forWho: Foreigners working in Zambia for more than six months, including NGO and church workers and volunteers.

categories.name: Investor's permit
categories.forWho: Foreigners over 18 setting up, investing in or joining a business in Zambia.

categories.name: Spouse permit
categories.forWho: Spouses of Zambian citizens or residents.

categories.name: Study permit
categories.forWho: Students at a Zambian school, college or university.

categories.name: Residence permit
categories.forWho: Long-term permit holders who qualify for permanent residence, and retirees who can show a pension, annuity or retirement funds.

generalDocuments: Valid passport (check the minimum validity rule)
Criminal record check (often needs an apostille)

officialLinks.label: Zambia Department of Immigration: permit types

visas.summary: Some nationalities can visit visa-free, many can get a visa on arrival or an e-visa, and others must apply in advance. Long stays need a permit from the Department of Immigration, with work and business permits applied for through its ePermits portal.

categories.name: Temporary employment permit
categories.forWho: Foreigners with a job offer from a Zimbabwean employer. Issued for up to 5 years in total.

categories.name: Investor residence permit
categories.forWho: Foreigners investing in a business in Zimbabwe.

categories.name: Retired persons' permit
categories.forWho: Retirees with a pension or income from abroad.

categories.name: Residence permit (family)
categories.forWho: Spouses and dependents of Zimbabwean citizens or residents.

generalDocuments: Valid passport (check the minimum validity rule)
Criminal record check (often needs an apostille)

schengen.note: Since Apr 10, 2026 the EU Entry/Exit System (EES) takes fingerprints and a photo at the border. ETIAS (the online travel authorization) is not running yet and has no confirmed start date; the EU will announce it months ahead.
